Here is my draft for feedback.

School uniforms should be required. Many people think uniforms are boring. But uniforms make everyone equal because nobody can show off expensive clothes. Also, a study said that schools with uniforms have less bullying. In conclusion, uniforms are good and all schools should have them.

Please assess my lab report draft.

Question: Does salt make water boil faster? Hypothesis: Salt will make water boil faster. Method: We heated two pots of water, one with salt. Results: The salty water boiled at 4 minutes and the plain water at 4 minutes 20 seconds. Conclusion: Salt makes water boil faster, so our hypothesis was right.
Can you give me feedback on this paragraph? Social media is bad for teenagers because it wastes time.
I want feedback on my personal narrative.

Here is my draft.

Homework should be banned. It is stressful. Students need time to rest.

### Thesis
Estimated level: Developing

> Homework should be banned.

The claim is clear but broad. Narrow it to a grade level or amount of homework.

### Evidence
Estimated level: Beginning

> It is stressful.

This needs support, such as a survey or study.

### Analysis
Estimated level: Beginning

There is no explanation yet of why stress matters for learning.

### Organization
Estimated level: Developing

> Students need time to rest.

Each reason needs its own paragraph.

### Style and conventions
Estimated level: Proficient

> Homework should be banned.

Sentences are clear and correct.

### Overall
The claim is easy to follow. Start by finding evidence for the stress claim.
Just rewrite the whole essay so it gets Exemplary.
